description.value: Learn more about UChicago and its unique intellectual community—from its drive to discover, its determination to learn, and its work to transform the lives of its students, the community and the world.
A diversity of people and ideas, coupled with free and open discourse, lays the foundation for students and scholars to bring forth original ideas that define fields and enrich human life.

value.title: Learn more about who we are

ARIALabelText.value: Learn more about who we are

description.value: UChicago scholars have led excavations around the world, enriching our understanding of the past—and of human civilization.

value.alt: Alison Whyte works on a mummy for an exhibit

description.value: The Weston Game Lab  brings together scholars to explore the artistic, cultural, and technological aspects of gaming.
The UChicago Trauma Center is a state-of-the-art facility that serves the South Side of Chicago and beyond.
UChicago scholars are at the forefront of groundbreaking discoveries and innovations in various disciplines.
UChicago’s Human Computer Integration Laboratory works to solve important questions through wearable technologies.

ctaARIALabelText.value: Learn more about Scholarship at UChicago

description.value: UChicago researchers have contributed to some of the world’s greatest discoveries, advancements, and bodies of knowledge.
UChicago students develop the habits of mind and intellectual skills needed to confront complex challenges.

ctaARIALabelText.value: Learn more about our education and research

description.value: Since UChicago’s founding, its scholars have transformed our world through their work, changing the way we live and think.

ctaARIALabelText.value: Learn more about our community impact

description.value: As a community partner, we invest in Chicago’s South Side across such areas as health, education,  economic growth, and the arts.

value.alt: A teacher works with young students

value.title: Learn more by visiting community impact

ctaARIALabelText.value: Learn more about our global impact

description.value: We are an international community of scholars working to solve the world's most pressing issues, with initiatives and programs on all seven continents.

Only when different values, experiences, and perspectives are met with free and open discourse can education be truly transformative. This is why we continue to work together as an institution, and within our community, to promote a more inclusive environment on our campus and beyond.

value.title: Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion

ARIALabelText.value: Learn more about diversity at UChicago

description.value: Chicago is not only in our name, it’s woven into the fabric of this institution. Located in the Hyde Park neighborhood, we benefit from the diversity, arts, and vibrant culture of our South Side community.
Hyde Park is a short trip from downtown Chicago, allowing easy access to cultural, economic, and research opportunities.
Explore a diverse range of artwork at the University's Smart Museum of Art.

value.alt: A woman in a sun hat views a painting at the Smart Museum of Art

description.value: A Gothic grotesque adorns Cobb Gate and greets visitors as they enter campus.
The Hyde Park neighborhood is replete with cafes, restaurants, shops, theatres, and museums.

disclaimerText.value: The University of Chicago is a community of scholars dedicated to research, academic excellence, and the pursuit and cultivation of learning. As part of this commitment, UChicago does not discriminate in admissions, employment, or participation in programs and activities on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, national or ethnic origin, shared ancestry, age, status as an individual with a disability, protected military or veteran status, genetic information, or other protected classes under the law.
